title: Towards a user-centric HPC-QC environment
problem: Hybrid HPC-QPU systems lack robust execution environment for hybrid quantum-classical programs; integration challenges in scheduling, portability, and reproducibility.
motivation: Portable runtime environment needed for hybrid quantum-classical program development in HPC with QPU integration.
method: They designed a software intermediary (middleware) that improves hybrid HPC-quantum systems by adding a second scheduling stage after the main HPC scheduler. This second stage uses QRMI—a manufacturer-independent standard interface—to optimize when and how quantum processors (QPUs) run their tasks. The system includes monitoring and observability tools to show what's happening and help developers diagnose issues.
key_novelty: A second scheduling layer using vendor-neutral standards (QRMI) to optimize quantum processor use in hybrid HPC systems.
contributions: Portable runtime for hybrid quantum-classical HPC programs
